# Termux-Diffusion (v1.0.0)
> Non-Root On-Device Stable Diffusion Image Generation Framework for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
- Installation: `pip install termux-diffusion
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion`
- Architecture: Compiles C++ NEON kernels directly to Android Bionic libc, running Stable Diffusion v1.5 / Turbo entirely locally within 4GB RAM.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_diffusion as td

pipe = td.DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained("sd-turbo-arm64")
image = pipe.generate("A cinematic futuristic laboratory in Seoul", steps=4)
image.save("output.png")
```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
